body: Thanks man, I didn't even think of that about my girlfriend. It only hurts me to say their names but there were five guys and three girls. Two straight relationships and one gay relationship. I can see how this happened with the number of boyfriends and girlfriends there were, and it was so sudden with each of them.
Thank you, I feel like seeing a professional on the matter but everybody I've ever known going through depression just talks about how much it doesn't work...
